kinds.offline_runnable: Hermetic, no-account, no-network command this test executes directly and asserts exits zero.
kinds.offline_documented: A real, account-free, safe-to-run command. Not re-executed by this test because it duplicates a heavier check owned by another dedicated test/script, or depends on setup state (an activated venv, a prior init) this test does not construct.
kinds.manual: Touches a network install, an external account, admin privilege, or is otherwise destructive/non-idempotent to a shared resource. Never run by this documentation test.
kinds.illustrative: Not a literal runnable command: a template line with placeholder tokens, a YAML/SQL/text fixture, output text, or a directory listing.
